title: Application Backup Entity
description: Common properties shared by all backup applications (Restic, Borg, etc.).

schedule.description: Cron expression or systemd timer for backup schedule.

daily.description: Number of daily backups to retain.

weekly.description: Number of weekly backups to retain.

monthly.description: Number of monthly backups to retain.

yearly.description: Number of yearly backups to retain.

password_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for the encryption password.

paths.description: Paths to include in the backup.

exclude.description: Paths to exclude from the backup.
